validation_selection: Mean ROC-AUC over GenImage subset val and fixed 4000-image CIFAKE val, multi-crop inference; external data never used for gradients
format_balancing: Every generated GenImage training image, and BigGAN real photos after 128 px matching, JPEG-compressed at stored resolution with quality drawn from real training JPEGs; SD1.5 real photos keep their original JPEG
augmentations: Symmetric global rescale 0.5-1.0 (p=0.3), random native crop, flip, mild blur (p=0.1), crop JPEG quality 60-95 (p=0.5)
inference: Up to five native-resolution crops (centre and quadrant centres); images with short side below the crop are bilinearly upscaled; crop logits averaged

genimage.input_cache: EXIF transpose, RGB, PIL bilinear resize to 160x160, uint8; inference must use identical preprocessing
genimage.protected_data: All CIFAKE exact pixels plus all external-release exact and 64-bit DCT perceptual hashes; final labels/predictions are not used
genimage.split_method: 80/10/10 deterministic hash on whole exact/perceptual duplicate groups
genimage.near_duplicate_limit: Conservative pHash Hamming <=4 heuristic; not exhaustive and may exclude false matches

cifake.test_policy: author test partition retained; no training, tuning or calibration
cifake.duplicate_detection_limit: Exact decoded-pixel hashes only; no exhaustive perceptual-near-duplicate audit.
